content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF, if verification has been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00651]) and the dynamic DID has been defined with a DID source (see [SWS_Dcm_00646]), the Dcm module shall use the configuration of this DID source to read the data.
